verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents dedicated vertical endpoints selected via the `engine` parameter. These include a Google News API with topic-token and country filters, a Google Finance API covering stocks, price movements and related news, and separate Flights, Events, Ads Transparency, Autocomplete and AI Mode APIs. Its Google Search results also include Shopping, Maps and Local results. Google Finance markets currently accepts only `indexes` as a value. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of a dedicated images vertical, independent hands-on corroboration of the vertical endpoints.
